concerns.text: FR-016 requires deriving the statistical noise threshold (0.01) from a pilot run or cited model. No task exists to perform this pilot run, cite the model, or hardcode the derived value. T019 only tests the threshold, not its derivation.

SC-005 and SC-006 require handling execution failures in 95% of the 'Error Injection Dataset'. T038 only tasks generating this dataset. No task explicitly implements running the pipeline against this specific dataset to verify the 95% success rate.

SC-004 requires a 'diff check' to verify zero token overlap. T024 tasks integrating the independence_checker (string-hash per FR-015) but does not explicitly implement the 'diff check' logic or the specific output artifact required by SC-004.

FR-013 and SC-004 specify a 'Validation Dataset' of 200 manually labeled comments. T037 tasks creating the file but lacks a task to actually populate it with 200 manually labeled comments or a script to generate them, leaving the validation task (T035) without required input.

T023 and T028 reference 'Fairness Degradation Slopes' and 'slope of the fairness degradation curve', but FR-006 and SC-001 in the spec still define the target as 'Fairness Metrics' (static). The tasks implement the plan's methodology correction, but the spec requirements are not updated to match, creating a traceability gap.
